Jessie Jaeger in Cleopatra's Curse.name: Jessie Jaeger in Cleopatra's Curse
Jessie Jaeger in Cleopatra's Curse.summary: Jessie Jaeger in Cleopatra's Curse is a new metroidvania-style game for the Sega Genesis, Turbografx-16 and Turbografx Super CD! Explore Cleopatra's Crypt to find the pieces of her sarcophagus, and save your grandpa from her curse!
